rows.tests: slanted chop: advance tilted +15 deg inside a vertical blade plane on the solid board

prediction.basis: DEV feasibility (CPU geometry only, artifacts/wp12/phase4_e2_dev_001): the planner tilts the edge line with the advance (through_cut_rotation keeps the edge perpendicular to the advance) and ends the stroke with the edge CENTRE on the board top (_relief_end), so the low end of the 120 mm edge is 60 mm x sin 15 deg = 15.5 mm inside the solid board (blade_collision -15.53 mm at HOLD:cut0; ADV_m15 also knife_handle_clearance -6.5 mm). The prediction before that check was CONFIRMED. A valid flat-board slanted chop needs a planner change (stop at the lowest edge point), which is out of scope
